📝 Mayor's Blog Update (Published: November 1, 2026)

On Sunday, November 1st, I attended the final day of the Hisako Higuchi Mitsubishi Electric Ladies Golf Tournament 2026, held at Musashioka Golf Course, and received a donation ledger.

Middle school students from our city also participated as volunteers in the tournament.
